answer: Anchor each identity to one exclusive data source it alone may read, such as its owner's meter feed. That source emits a plume of signed readings, one per epoch, and the agent must cite the latest reading in its work. An honest agent reads its feed, nearly free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 real sources, since a source issues one credential; reusing one credential across fakes collapses them to one identity, and any attempt to forge a reading fails signature checks, voiding the fake. The attack costs 1,000 real data relationships, not one script.
